rules.rule: If a mark contains gradients or tonal ramps, it will fail the one-colour test because those distinctions merge when hue is removed.
rules.evidence: any part of a mark distinguished only by hue or by a tonal ramp merges the moment the ramp is gone

rules.rule: If a mark has hairline strokes thinner than the pixel width at 16px, it will fail the favicon size test as lines fall below resolution.
rules.evidence: At favicon size the hairlines fall below the width of a pixel

rules.rule: If a mark contains thin counters or narrow gaps smaller than one-third of stroke width, it may close completely when scaled to minimum sizes like 7mm.
rules.evidence: At 7 mm it is a large fraction of a small gap, so the top row loses a little and the bottom row closes completely

rules.rule: If a mark is placed next to nine competitors in the same category at 24px, it will likely fail distinctiveness tests as users cannot point to their own.
rules.evidence: Three blue circular swooshes in one market means none of them is doing the job from What a logo does
